integrity: The result uses a complete analytic proof and separately executable numerical corroboration; no independent review, mathematical certification, or publication is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed full-dimensional compact planar convex bodies; uniformly random common rotation; tight axis-aligned bounding-rectangle perimeter divided by the body perimeter. No assertion for rectangle area, higher dimensions, nonconvex bodies or minimum-orientation enclosures. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Sharp convex-order dominance for randomly oriented bounding-rectangle perimeters
